title: Merchandising Operations Manager
description: Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good. Merchandising Operations Manager Grove's merchandising operation is full of good instincts running on manual work. This role exists to fix that: redesign the core processes, then personally build the automation that makes them stick. This is a rare shot at rebuilding how merchandising actually runs, and at proving AI belongs in the hands of the person closest to the problem, not just the AI team. We're not hiring someone to write a strategy memo about AI and hand it off. We're hiring someone who will map the workflow, feel where it breaks, and then sit down and build the thing that fixes it. More About the Opportunity Merchandising at Grove runs on real expertise and too much manual glue. Buyers chase vendors for the same data, week after week. Marketing launches promotions inventory finds out about too late. Good people spend their time on work a workflow should be doing for them. We have an internal AI team. They coach. They don't build for you. This role is for the person who wants their hands on the keyboard, not the person who scopes it and waits. The honest version: no template here. You're defining the standard as you go, with review at key milestones and real autonomy in between. Some of what you build will work on the first try. Some won't. That's the job. What You'll Own Map how merchandising actually works today, not how the org chart says it works. Redesign core operating processes for speed, accuracy, and margin protection: assortment planning, item setup, pricing and markdown, vendor and PO management, allocation, replenishment. Own the calendar connecting marketing activations to inventory, so launches are stock-backed, not a surprise to the warehouse. Translate activation plans into buy, allocation, and replenishment signals; flag stock risk before launch, not after. Coordinate vendor commitments tied to activations: fill rates, lead times, launch quantities. Build self-service tools and proactive alerts that scale the buyer-vendor relationship, including visibility into vendor performance. Build the automation yourself, using Claude and comparable AI tools, no/low-code platforms, and lightweight automation, from concept through rollout. Run pilots end to end: scope, build, test for accuracy, validate fit, scale. Keep humans in the loop on margin- and inventory-critical decisions. Maintain a registry of approved tools and active automations, so what exists and what it's for is never a mystery. Own change management for every rollout: training, AI literacy for non-technical audiences, office hours, a bench of power users. Build reporting on process and automation performance, and use it to prioritize what gets built next. About You Real fluency in retail merchandising operations, not an adjacent function you've watched from a distance. You've mapped a broken process and redesigned it, not just diagnosed it. Basic technical acumen and a genuine willingness to build, no engineering background required. Comfortable working with a specialist team as a coaching resource, not a build team, and taking their guidance without handing off your job. You've run a pilot from scoping through adoption, and you know the gap between a demo and something people actually use. You care about the boring, durable stuff: documentation, SOPs, registries, training, the things that outlast the person who built them. You think in workflows and root causes, not tickets. You know the difference between a problem worth automating and one worth leaving alone. Even Better if You Have Built something with Claude or a comparable AI tool that a non-technical team now relies on. Experience connecting marketing or demand planning to inventory and allocation. Designed a self-service tool that measurably cut manual buyer-vendor back-and-forth. A retail, CPG, or commerce background with real fluency in vendor and marketplace dynamics. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts. Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental Equity - shared success is core to our mission Flexible Paid Time Off - we care most about results Free VIP membership and 50% employee discount Working for a company that believes that a small group of people can change the world for the better by creating products and funding initiatives that help the planet! COMPENSATION The salary range for this role is $135,000-165,000. Our compensation bands are determined based on market-specific cost of living data, meaning that the top of our salary range is reserved for the most experienced candidates in the highest cost of living areas across the country. In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for an annual incentive target and equity. MORE ABOUT GROVE Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GROV) is the one-stop online destination for everyday essentials that create a healthier home and planet. Explore thousands of thoughtfully vetted products for every room and everyone in your home, including household cleaning, personal care, health and wellness, laundry, clean beauty, kitchen, pantry, kids, baby, pet care, and beyond. Everything Grove sells meets a higher standard â from health to sustainability and performance â so you get a great value without compromising your values. As a B Corp and Public Benefit Corporation, Grove goes beyond selling products: every order is carbon neutral, supports plastic waste cleanup initiatives, and lets you see and track the positive impact of your choices. Shopping with purpose starts at Grove.com. We're building a diverse and inclusive work environment where we learn from each other. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to Talent@grove.co. For information on our privacy policy, visit this link on our website. Position Overview

UFC GYM is seeking a Junior Designer to join our in-house marketing team. Reporting to the Lead Designer, this role supports the creative execution of brand campaigns, member acquisition initiatives, new club openings, and field marketing programs across our corporate and franchise network. This is a hands-on production and design role â ideal for a creative who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes direction well, and is excited to grow within a globally recognized fitness brand.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Design & Production

  • Create original graphic designs supporting company initiatives, including promotions, member acquisition campaigns, events, partnerships, and internal communications
  • Take approved concepts and designs from the Lead Designer and scale a single design across multiple formats, sizes, and channels (digital display, social, email, in-club signage, print collateral)
  • Ensure all creative output adheres to UFC GYM brand standards, templates, and style guidelines
  • Prepare print-ready and web-optimized files with accurate specs, bleeds, and color profiles


New Club Openings & Remodels

  • Develop and execute gym graphics plans for new club openings and remodels, including wall graphics, wayfinding, window clings, and environmental branding
  • Coordinate with vendors, printers, and field teams to ensure accurate production and installation of location graphics


Asset Management

  • Upload, organize, and maintain creative assets within the company's asset management platform, ensuring files are current, properly named, and accessible to corporate and franchise stakeholders
  • Support the marketing team in fulfilling creative asset requests from franchise locations and field teams


Team Support

  • Participate in creative briefings, provide production timelines, and manage multiple concurrent projects against deadlines
  • Support photo and video needs for events, club openings, and content capture as needed

  • Experience working with Dropbox or similar cloud-based file management systems
  • Strong understanding of design fundamentals: typography, layout, hierarchy, and color

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities
  • Portfolio required with application


Preferred Qualifications

  • Photography, videography, and video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or equivalent) â highly preferred
  • Experience with large-format print production and environmental graphics
  • Familiarity with fitness, sports, or lifestyle brands
  • Experience supporting multi-location or franchise organizations
  • Motion graphics or animation experience


Benefits

  • Full-time position with benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Complimentary UFC GYM membership
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Growth opportunity within a global fitness brand

This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. description: Who we areâ¦ Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 10,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities. â¯ What you'll be doingâ¦ As Vice President, Field Services, you will be a visionary and strategic leader responsible for orchestrating the success of our North American Field Services organization. You will oversee regional field operations, the Remote Technical Support Team (Command Center) department, Fleet Management, driving operational excellence, innovation, and scalability across a complex network of internal teams and third-party partners. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of field services, balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution. Your leadership will be essential in transforming operations through data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and a relentless focus on customer experience and cost control. â¯ Lead and evolve the Field Services organization, including internal teams and third-party vendors, to deliver consistent, high-quality service across the U.S. and Canada. Oversee Command Center operations to ensure real-time monitoring, incident response, problem management, and service continuity. Direct Fleet Management strategy, optimizing asset utilization, maintenance, and lifecycle planning. Manage multiple operational P&Ls, including forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking. Champion a customer-focused culture and lead change management initiatives that align with enterprise goals. Develop and execute strategic plans across people, processes, and technology to support growth and scalability. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve operational challenges, improve service delivery, and enhance field technician support. Apply continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma to streamline processes and reduce defects. Monitor key performance indicators and use data analytics to drive decision-making and operational enhancements. Represent Field Services in executive forums, contributing to enterprise-wide strategy and planning. Other duties as assigned. What we're looking forâ¦ You are a visionary and strategic leader with a proven ability to scale and transform complex operations while driving service excellence across diverse teams and geographies. You bring a strong command of operational strategy, financial acumen, and performance management, paired with a deep understanding of field services, command center operations, and fleet management. Your communication skills enable you to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, while your analytical mindset supports data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement. You thrive in dynamic environments, lead through change with confidence, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and customer focus. You'll need to have: BS/BA degree required 7+ years of experience leading Field Services operations 7+ years of experience leading Remote Technical Support (Command Center) operations 2+ years of experience leading Fleet Management operations Experience leading geographically dispersed teams across North America or globally. Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide initiatives at the executive level, including demonstrated skills ranging from work direction, motivation, coaching/feedback, and developing assigned staff with the expected outcome of consistently positive client experience and SLA attainment. Excellent organizational and time management skills, ability to take the initiative, use good judgment, demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and follow-up, and carry multiple projects through to completion. Qualified candidates will possess exceptional statistical/analytical skills, exemplary problem-solving abilities, and show initiative to get ahead of potential out-of-compliance processes . Proven track record of building and maintaining good internal and external working relationships. Demonstrated business process engineering/re-engineering experience using Six Sigma, Lean, or other formal process improvement methodology. Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills, including a collaborative management style. â¯ Even better if you have one or more of the following: MBA or Master's in Operations Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field. Lean Six Sigma Training and Certification (Green belt or Black belt) PMP (Project Management Professional) ITIL4 Certification Experience in the photo enforcement industry â¯ Where you'll be workingâ¦ In this remote role , you'll have the flexibility to work from home full-time, allowing you to create an optimal work environment. You'll also have regular check-ins and team meetings scheduled through virtual platforms to ensure collaboration and support. This role requires up to 50% travel across North America to engage with teams, oversee operations, and support strategic initiatives. Aligned with Verra Mobility Values Do What's Right â We've committed to doing the right thing for each other and for our customers â integrity is our DNA Lead With Grace â We embrace the importance of our colleagues and customers and always treat them with kindness and grace. Own It â We foster a culture of accountability and excellence, where going the extra mile is standard practice. Win Together â We are ambitious and like to win, but we know we win more when we include others and work together. Verra Mobility Values An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values: Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation. Do What's Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous. Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease. Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others. In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. About us

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company â it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

About the role

LifeMD is seeking a strategic, data-obsessed Director of Customer Experience to lead and elevate our remote customer operations. This role sits at the intersection of technology, clinical empathy, and operational excellence. We are looking for someone who has built and continuously evolved high-performing, technology-enabled CX organizations; deploying AI voice and chat tools, engineering data-driven performance cultures, and creating differentiated, concierge-level experiences that drive loyalty and growth.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience, you will translate the executive team's vision and strategy into operational reality,surfacing the voice of the customer, driving measurable performance, and partnering cross-functionally to embed customer insights into decisions across the organization. If you thrive in fast-moving health tech environments and believe exceptional customer experience is a commercial advantage, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Remote Contact Center Leadership

  • Lead, scale, and continuously optimize a remote contact center team across multiple channels (voice, chat, email, SMS). Setting KPIs, driving performance expectations, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Set and enforce service level standards, workforce management practices, scheduling, capacity models, and escalation protocols
  • Build a high-accountability, coaching-first culture across team leads and frontline agents

Customer Experience

  • Develop and maintain service blueprints and experience standards across contact and service touchpoints that transform support from a transactional function into a driver of loyalty and advocacy
  • Champion a culture of empathy, accountability, and customer-centricity across the entire CX organization

AI & Technology Integration

  • Own the performance of AI-powered support functions including AI voice (conversational IVR), chatbots, and agent-assist tools â monitoring deflection rates, containment quality, sentiment signals, and escalation patterns
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate, implement, and iterate on AI tooling that augments agent performance and improves resolution rates without sacrificing human connection
  • Ensure deep integration between CX technology and broader customer-facing platforms including EHR, CRM, and marketing automation systems
  • â¢ Stay current on emerging customer support technologies and serve as the internal subject matter expert on responsible AI use within a healthcare context

Data-Driven Performance Management

  • Define, track, and improve core CX metrics: first contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, NPS, escalation rate, AI containment rate, retention, and reactivation
  • Monitor NPS trends surfaced through the CX function and partner with the Manager of Patient Experience to close the loop on customer feedback and drive operational improvements
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting cadences that provide real-time operational visibility to your team and to the SVP
  • Conduct root cause analysis on performance gaps and translate findings into structured improvement plans
  • Synthesize customer insights, VOC data, and operational trends into clear, executive-ready briefings

Commercial Impact & Customer Lifecycle

  • Align CX operations with revenue and retention goals, connecting CSAT, NPS, and resolution metrics to commercial outcomes including retention, upsell conversion, and reactivation
  • Identify patterns in customer friction that represent risk to renewal, referral, or acquisition, and advocate for fixes cross-functionally
  • Support onboarding and activation workflows that reduce time-to-value; contribute to behavioral engagement and churn prediction strategies

Quality Assurance

  • Design and maintain a rigorous QA framework covering interaction quality, compliance, empathy standards, and clinical accuracy
  • Establish calibration processes across QA reviewers to ensure scoring consistency and fairness
  • Use QA insights to inform targeted coaching, training curricula, and process improvement

Budget Management

  • Manage the CX department budget within parameters, including headcount planning, vendor contracts, and technology spend
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising service quality or customer outcomes; present trade-off analyses and recommendations

Remote Transition & Operational Build-Out

  • Lead the operational transition to a fully remote customer service model, owning the end-to-end migration across people, process, technology, and compliance workstreams
  • Partner with HR, IT, Legal, and Operations to execute the transition with minimal disruption to the customer experience, establishing remote workforce policies and tooling standards
  • Use the transition as an opportunity to redesign foundational processes and eliminate legacy inefficiencies

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of managers, team leads, QA specialists, trainers, and agents
  • Build workforce planning, career pathing, and succession pipelines within the CX organization
  • Design the management rhythms, coaching frameworks, and recognition programs that attract and retain top talent in a fully remote environment

Cross-Functional Partnership & Internal Alignment

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the Manager of Patient Experience, ensuring alignment between customer-facing service operations and the broader patient experience program
  • Collaborate closely with the Manager of Patient Experience to align on messaging touchpoints, technology integrations, and shared data â recognizing that the customer journey spans both functions and requires active coordination to deliver a coherent experience
  • Support the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience in executing the overall CX vision, roadmap, and resource planning
  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical, Marketing, Sales, and Finance to embed the customer perspective in upstream decisions
  • Prepare structured insights, trend analyses, and investment recommendations for the SVP to carry into executive forums

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive CX, contact center, or customer operations leadership experience, with direct people management responsibility
  • Demonstrated experience leading remote or distributed teams of 50 or more across multiple channels and functions
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing AI/automation in a customer service context (chatbots, conversational IVR, agent-assist tools)
  • Strong analytical skills â comfortable building dashboards, interpreting performance data, and translating insights into operational action
  • Proven track record connecting CX performance to commercial outcomes including retention, reactivation, and revenue
  • Experience managing vendor relationships including BPO partners and technology providers
  • Experience building or maturing QA programs in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a department budget, including headcount, vendor, and technology spend

Preferred

  • Background in health tech, digital health, telehealth, or healthcare services
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements as they apply to CX operations, technology platforms, and data handling
  • Experience with platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Five9, Genesys, or similar CRM/WFM tools
  • Exposure to customer and patient experience frameworks (e.g., service blueprinting, NPS program design, churn prediction models)
  • Background in a direct-to-consumer or subscription-based business where CX plays a direct role in lifetime value

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plans
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Flexible PTO Policy
  • Paid Holidays
  • Short Term Disability
  • Training & Development

  • Partner with client services teams to align recommendations with client priorities, budgets, and long-term goals

Creative Leadership

  • Establish the strategic and creative vision for client engagements
  • Develop creative briefs with clear direction, measurable objectives, and actionable guidance
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across branding, web, UX/UI, content, digital marketing, and campaign development
  • Provide thoughtful creative direction and feedback that strengthens ideas and maintains brand integrity
  • Ensure work is strategically grounded, human-centered, and aligned with business outcomes
  • Mentor designers, writers, strategists, and other creative team members
  • Help foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing creative culture

Client Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Present creative concepts, brand strategies, and campaign recommendations with confidence
  • Facilitate conversations that connect business goals with creative opportunities
  • Build alignment across client stakeholders and internal teams
  • Collaborate with account and project management teams to support successful delivery while protecting strategic and creative integrity

Research & Strategic Planning

  • Lead stakeholder interviews, audience research, competitive analysis, surveys, and workshop facilitation
  • Synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and executive-ready presentations
  • Apply design thinking and human-centered problem-solving to uncover meaningful insights
  • Monitor trends in branding, customer behavior, digital experiences, marketing, technology, and AI-enabled solutions
  • Contribute strategic and creative thinking to new business opportunities

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience leading brand, digital, or integrated creative initiatives within an agency or consulting environment
  • Proven experience developing brand strategies, creative campaigns, digital experiences, and integrated marketing initiatives
  • Strong understanding of branding, UX/UI, web design, digital marketing, content strategy, and customer experience
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across strategy, design, content, marketing, and technology
  • Exceptional storytelling, facilitation, presentation, and executive communication skills
  • Ability to translate complex business challenges into simple, compelling creative solutions
  • Experience presenting to executive leadership and facilitating strategic workshops
  • Strong understanding of modern digital ecosystems, including websites, CMS platforms, paid media, marketing automation, analytics, and emerging AI-enabled experiences
  • Collaborative leadership style grounded in curiosity, empathy, accountability, and continuous learning

Why This Role

  • Contract opportunity with a collaborative, design-driven agency
  • Lead strategic and creative work across diverse client engagements
  • Shape brand strategies, digital experiences, and integrated campaigns
  • Partner directly with executive stakeholders and marketing leaders
  • Mentor multidisciplinary creative teams and elevate creative standards
  • Contribute to new business growth and agency thought leadership
  • Balance creative excellence with measurable business impact

If you are a strategic creative leader who enjoys building brands, guiding teams, and shaping digital experiences that move organizations forward, we would love to connect.

Full-time

LOCATION

Remote and HQ in Edinburgh when required

Overview

Weâre looking for a UX Designer who thrives on solving complex problems and making digital experiences feel effortless. You care about clarity, usability, and reducing friction â not just shipping pretty screens.

This role sits at the heart of how users engage with Caledonia. Youâll shape flows, build systems, and help turn financial services into something people actually enjoy using.

If you think like a designer but move like a product builder, we want to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user experiences across web and mobile products
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to shape feature direction and UX priorities
  • Translate product requirements into wireframes, prototypes, and detailed visual designs
  • Run user research, usability testing, and iterate based on real feedback
  • Develop and maintain UX patterns and documentation to ensure consistency
  • Help define and evolve the design language and component library
  • Present design decisions clearly and advocate for user needs in every conversation

  • 3 or more years of experience in UX, interaction design, or product design
  • A strong portfolio that shows how you solve real-world problems through design
  • Proven experience designing digital products, not just landing pages or marketing sites
  • Excellent understanding of design tools like Figma, along with prototyping and handoff workflows
  • Comfortable working alongside engineers and product managers in agile teams
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain design thinking clearly
  • A mindset of constant learning, with a sharp eye for detail and improvement

Venture Media is a full-service content marketing agency. We help businesses grow through social media, podcast production, SEO and AI visibility, and full-funnel content systems. We are a small, fast-moving remote team that ships real client work every week.


The role

We are looking for a Marketing Assistant to support content production and daily execution across our client accounts and internal brands. You will keep the content engine running: scheduling posts, prepping assets, and running research. Your job will be across assistant and marketing work, so you should like variety.


Marketing expertise is a plus for this role, but it is not required. What matters most is having a basic understanding of marketing and a genuine desire to learn and develop deeper expertise. We use automation and clear systems for the heavy lifting, so your job is less about busywork and more about keeping things organized, checking quality, and helping our content and clients look great. You will work directly with the founder and learn how a modern agency runs end to end.


What you will do

  • Content coordination and publishing. Schedule and publish blogs and posts, keep our content calendar organized, and make sure everything goes out on time. Much of the writing is already automated, so your role is organizing, reviewing, and adding the final human touch.
  • Quality control. Do a first pass on assets from our editors, proofread copy and decks before they go to clients, and make sure feedback actually gets addressed.
  • Research and reporting. Run market research for projects as needed, and help pull simple analytics reports so we know what is working.
  • Social and community support. Help manage engagement and distribution across our platforms, and keep our own brand active and consistent.
  • Light marketing execution. Learn the basics of SEO and AI search visibility, and help apply them to our content. We will teach you this piece by piece.
  • General right-hand work. Jump on whatever the day needs. Some days that is research, some days it is organizing a project in our task tools, some days it is prepping something for a client.


What we are looking for

  • Bachelor's in a related field or equivalent hands-on experience
  • 1 to 2 years in a marketing, social media, communications, or administrative role, ideally at an agency 
  • Extremely organized and proactive, able to juggle multiple priorities and stay detailed under deadline
  • Comfortable with the major social platforms (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) and scheduling tools
  • Familiar with project management software
  • A reliable communicator who keeps managers updated and follows through without being chased
  • A flexible team player who adapts to shifting priorities and jumps in where needed
  • Clear written English and comfort in an async remote setup
  • Available during US Pacific business hours so we can work in real time
  • Dedicated to this as your main full-time focus, not a side gig


Nice to have (not required)

  • SEO or AI search visibility experience
  • Experience with task managers like ClickUp


Who this is not for

This is not a fit if you need constant hand-holding, avoid feedback, or prefer slow work with a lot of meetings. We move fast, hold clear standards, and expect you to own your tasks.


What you get

  • An hourly rate of $20 to $25 USD, based on your experience.
  • Direct mentorship from the founder and a front-row seat to how a marketing agency runs
  • Real room to grow. As we grow, you grow, in both responsibility and pay
  • A long-term home, not a short-term contract


How to apply

Submit your resume and a short note about yourself, and answer this one question: what is one thing you would most want to get better at in this role, and why?


We read every application that answers it.

Job Summary

We are MHCLG

Here at the Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government (MHCLG), we work on things that make a real difference to peopleâs lives. Whether it's through the homes we live in, the work of our local councils, or the communities weâre all part of, our work is at the top of the political agenda. We have ambitious and far-reaching outcomes to achieve, so thereâs never been a more exciting time to join us.

This Performance Analyst role will be part of our Elections Digital team at MHCLG. Itâs an exciting time to improve and expand our services to meet usersâ needs.

Our Services Include

  • Register to vote
  • Apply for a proxy vote
  • Apply for a postal vote
  • Apply for photo ID to vote (called a âVoter Authority Certificateâ)
  • And a product we have built for electoral teams in Local Authorities to support electoral administration.

We have lots to do. We must continue to improve our existing services to meet the needs of our users, especially those of disabled and other marginalised users. We must also think strategically about the future, understanding what problems still exist and champion user-centred ways of working to approach these issues.

You will be embedded in the Operations team, providing statistics and analysis for an existing portfolio of high-profile online services. Moreover, a substantial part of your responsibilities will be working with the Product and Design teams in Elections Digital, who are busy developing entirely new and exciting online services to improve voter registration as part of the Electoral Resilience & Democratic Engagement Programme.â¯â¯

This role will involve working closely with the development team on supporting user research and various analytics for services in various stages of development, and also performing analytics and continuous improvement to our existing services.â¯â¯

The role will also focus on supporting improvements to our digital compliance, making sure that we have proportionate data governance across the operational portfolio of live services that is aligned with MHCLG and data governance frameworks.

description: Dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining organized business operations, our company is seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Data Entry File Clerk to join our team. If you excel at managing records, entering data accurately, and working independently in a remote environment, this opportunity may be the perfect fit for you. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining digital files, updating databases, organizing administrative records, and ensuring information is entered accurately and efficiently. Your attention to detail, reliability, and commitment to data accuracy will play an important role in supporting daily operations and helping our team stay organized and productive. Â Key responsibilities: Â Intake & indexing. Receive files from shared inboxes, portals, internal ticketing tools, and cloud folders. Confirm document type, required fields, signatures, and attachments. Index each record using standard metadata (client/project ID, date, document category, version, region). Â Document organization. Apply standardized naming conventions and folder structures. Convert formats when needed (PDF merge/split, image-to-PDF, compressing, version labeling). Coordinate with HR, Finance, Operations, Legal, or Customer teams to clarify file requirements. Provide status updates on backlog, turnaround time, and issues found during processing. Â Tools you may use: Â Cloud storage (Google Drive/SharePoint/Dropbox), document tools (Adobe Acrobat or equivalents), spreadsheets, ticketing (Jira/Asana/ServiceNow), e-signature platforms, and basic office productivity tools. Success metrics (examples): Accuracy rate (misfile/metadata error rate) Turnaround time from receipt to filed Backlog size and daily throughput Audit retrieval speed and completeness Compliance adherence (access control, retention tagging) Â Qualifications: Â Experience in records management, admin support, clerical work, or document control (preferred). title: Product Marketing Manager
description: At AlixPartners, we tackle complex challenges by transforming insights into innovative solutions, delivering lasting value for businesses, their people, and the communities they serve. Our products are designed to drive meaningful impact, ensuring sustainable growth and success. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity of thoughts and experiences bring to our firm, and are committed to the perpetual enhancement of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.  AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees' work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person and remote working. This role follows a different cadence to traditional consulting or on-site client presence. It follows a traditional product development cadence, while being expected to engage our users in appropriate situations such as business conferences and in-person workshops.  What you'll do  As Product Marketing Manager at AlixPartners, your primary responsibility is to own and manage the marketing programs around the firmâs growing portfolio of technology products. These are typically used on client engagements, and a large part of the role is driving internal awareness, adoption, and engagement across practitioners and client-facing teams.  You will translate complex capabilities into clear value narratives, building internal and external marketing programs This role spans the full Platforms portfolio, with responsibility for raising awareness holistically across all products and initiatives, not just individual releases. You will work hand-in-hand with the Product Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to turn feature releases into awareness moments, and usage gaps into engagement campaigns.  Key Responsibilities Product Branding and Content Development.  Partner with Product Managers, industry and service lines, and the wider marketing team to define the market-facing identity of each product in the Platforms portfolio. Establish and maintain clear value propositions, positioning statements, and messaging frameworks aligned with the firm's wider brand proposition and visual identity standards. Lead the productization process â translating product capabilities into market-ready narratives. Brief and direct creative teams on product naming, visual identity, and brand standards. Drive the development of core go-to-market content, including digital assets and sales material, ensuring a cohesive product presence before and beyond any individual launch. Create high-quality product content including demos, feature walkthroughs, onboarding materials, and release announcements. Concept, brief and direct agency/contractors to produce video content to a professional standard. Maintain and improve internal knowledge bases, wiki pages, and public-facing product pages to ensure content stays current and accurate. Internal Product Promotion and Awareness Build and execute internal marketing campaigns that drive product visibility, feature adoption, and top-of-mind awareness across business units and geographies. Ensure consistent messaging across channels. This includes firm-wide awareness initiatives that promote the Platforms portfolio as a whole, beyond individual product launches.  Product Demos and Showcases Deliver live and recorded product demonstrations for internal stakeholders, new internal users, and leadership. Present new features in a way that connects directly to user needs and business outcomes.  Stakeholder Engagement Build relationships with key stakeholders across the firm. Understand their workflows, pain points, and communication preferences. Translate that knowledge into targeted campaigns that resonate with specific user groups.  Marketing Collaboration Serve as the primary bridge between the Platforms product team and the central marketing function, operating with a close dotted-line relationship to the marketing team. This role collaborates across teams, contributing to a wide variety of marketing initiatives and projects. Working alongside experienced marketing leaders, the Marketing Associate will build a broad foundation across campaign marketing, product marketing, content strategy, customer marketing, field marketing and events, sales enablement, and go-to-market execution while helping the team operate more efficiently as Red Rover continues to grow.

Marketing campaign & program support
